_: Every role starts free (wiki/decisions: the OS molds to the agents, #61): any shell command, reading and editing any file, skills and subagents. Denied is only what the person's rules protect: their screen and focus, data without a backup (the Windows drives, the backups themselves), secrets, what leaves the machine (pushing, the web: not granted yet), the rule records, deciding tickets outside the store's rules, and ad-hoc system changes (sudo; the system changes through the repository and odd1-deploy). A role's own settings.json adds to this (its job's tools, its own denials); role.toml `free = false` opts a role out. Tested against Claude Code: each command of a chain (`a && b`) is checked on its own, `Bash(*text*)` matches text anywhere in a command, and Edit rules cover every file-writing tool.
